verdict.rationale: Base44 offers an SDK/CLI for CRUD on entities and backend management (base44-docs-4,5,17,23,28), and even lets external AI assistants interact via an MCP server (base44-docs-7), but there is no discoverable OpenAPI spec (base44-probe-2) and core UI-only capabilities like AI-driven design generation, visual page editing, and templating (base44-docs-12,13,14,20) appear to have no programmatic equivalent, so full UI parity via API is not evidenced.
